transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I'm here because... well, mostly I just don't feel like myself anymore. It's getting pretty bad. I've just stopped doing everything I used to do. I used to go hiking, I coached, played my guitar... but I've dropped all of it. I don't even call people back lately. 

It's just... some days, I sit in my small rental for hours. I know there are things I need to get done, I can think of them, but I just can't make myself start. I just sit there.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
I'd say... well, things have really been unraveling since I moved into this smaller rental. That was right after my divorce, so... about a year and two months ago.
Before your divorce and the move, had you ever gone through a period where you felt down or lost interest in things like this?

No, not like this. I mean, I... I never really had a time where I just stopped caring about things before. 

Before the divorce, I was always pretty active. I worked my regular shifts, did my coaching, stayed busy. I never just sat around unable to get up and do things. This is all completely new.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually energized, euphoric, or wired, needing much less sleep than normal?

No, I haven't. I've always just kind of had a normal amount of energy, I guess. I mean, I'd get tired after a long shift or a hike, and I'd sleep a regular eight hours. I've never had a time where I felt wired or like I didn't need to sleep. It's really just been the opposite lately.
Over the past few weeks, have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless for most of the day, almost every day?

No, I wouldn't say I feel sad. Or hopeless. I mean... I'm not sitting around crying or feeling down in the dumps all day. It's not really like that. I just haven't been doing my usual stuff, like I said, but I don't feel sad.
Even when you have the opportunity, do you find that you've lost interest or get no pleasure from the things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I guess you could say that. Mostly I just don't feel like myself anymore. I mean, I used to do a lot... I stopped hiking, stopped coaching. I haven't picked up my guitar in months. Even when people call, I just... I don't call them back. Some days I just sit in that small rental for hours. I know there are things I should be doing, things I used to like doing, but I just can't make myself start. There's just no interest there anymore.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, such as having trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or sleeping more than usual?

No, my sleep has been pretty normal. I mean, I go to bed, I sleep through the night, and I wake up in the morning. I haven't had any trouble falling asleep, and I'm not sleeping, you know, all day or anything like that. It's just the usual amount.
How have your energy levels been lately?
My energy is fine, honestly. I'm not... I don't feel tired or wiped out or anything. I have the energy to do things, I just... don't do them. So physically, I feel okay. Just normal energy, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?
No, my appetite is about the same. I eat when I'm supposed to, mostly. I haven't noticed any weight gain or loss... my clothes still fit the same. So, no real changes there.
Have you been struggling with feeling worthless, or feeling down on yourself with excessive guilt?

No, not really. I don't feel guilty about anything, and I don't feel worthless. I mean, I don't really have a reason to feel guilty. I just kind of exist right now, I guess. So, no, I haven't been feeling down on myself like that.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to end your life, or feeling like you would be better off dead?
No, I haven't. I don't... I don't have any thoughts about ending my life. I'm not wishing I was dead or anything like that. So, no, nothing like that.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

Yeah, I do. It sounds like... short, radio-like voices. Kind of like dispatch, but my scanner is actually turned off when it happens. They usually warn me that someone is inside, or they tell me that I'm being watched. And I guess along with that, I sometimes see a shadow move past the hallway at home. I'll have just cleared every room, so I know the house is secure, but I still see it go by. So, yes, that does happen to me.
Do you believe that people are genuinely spying on you, watching you, or trying to harm you?

Yes, I do. I know it sounds extreme, but... for months now, I've been certain that the guys across from my rental, and even some people at work, are tracking my patrol routes. I know they're testing my locks, too. It's just that the same cars keep showing up, and they make these little comments that line up way too perfectly to just be random. So, yes, I do believe I'm being watched.
